name: person-evidence
description: The subject (a type, a method or a repository) shows that people use the system in the way the value names: role (a role or authority that Spring Security, Jakarta or a Keycloak realm names), membership (a type about members of something, such as an organization), invitation (a type about invitations people receive) or route (a screen of a frontend, by its path). It records only what the code says; the linker decides which people it makes of it.

name.description: For a role, the role as the code names it, without the ROLE_ prefix.

source.description: For a role, where it is named: the annotation (PreAuthorize, PostAuthorize, Secured, RolesAllowed), the security call (hasRole, hasAnyRole, hasAuthority, hasAnyAuthority) or keycloak-realm.

serviceAccountOnly.description: For a Keycloak realm role, present and true when only service accounts hold it, so it names software, not a kind of person.

scope.description: For a membership, the word before Member in the type's name, such as Organization; absent when the name has none.

type.description: For a membership or an invitation, the binary name of the type.

path.description: For a route, the path as the frontend's router writes it.

framework.description: For a route, the router: angular, react or vue.
